patterns.name: Office Application Spawning Shell (Macro Execution)
patterns.description: Detects Microsoft Office processes (WINWORD.EXE, EXCEL.EXE) spawning cmd.exe or powershell.exe.
patterns.cql: #repo = "endpoint-edr-logs" ParentBaseFileName = /^(winword|excel|powerpnt)\.exe$/i ImageFileName = /^(cmd|powershell|pwsh|wscript|cscript)\.exe$/i | select([@timestamp, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine])

patterns.name: LOLBin Network Download (Certutil / BITSAdmin)
patterns.description: Detects living-off-the-land binaries executing command lines containing HTTP/HTTPS download flags.
patterns.cql: #repo = "endpoint-edr-logs" ImageFileName = /^(certutil|bitsadmin)\.exe$/i CommandLine = /(-urlcache|-split|transfer)/i | select([@timestamp, ComputerName, UserName, CommandLine])

patterns.name: PowerShell Encoded Command Execution
patterns.description: Spots PowerShell sessions executing base64-encoded command parameters (-enc, -encodedcommand).
patterns.cql: #repo = "endpoint-edr-logs" ImageFileName = /^(powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i CommandLine = /(-e|-enc|-encodedcommand)\s+[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{20,}/i | select([@timestamp, ComputerName, UserName, CommandLine])
